Part Name: CI for Old William Penn Highway Landslide Project Description: ECMS 120079 Old William Penn Highway Landslide:Roadway preservation and slide remediation located on the 4000 block of Old William Penn Hwy in the Municipality of Penn Hills, Allegheny County.
